subject: english
question:
Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose 'No improvement as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.

It will __none rained__ in the West this summer.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect usage of the word "**none**" which is not suitable in this context.
 
• The correct usage should be "**not rain**" to convey the intended meaning.
 
• The phrase "**It will not rain**" is grammatically correct and makes sense in the context of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It will** not r**ain in the West this summer."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "no rained"** – This is grammatically incorrect and does not fit the context.
 
• **Option 2: "not have raining"** – This is also grammatically incorrect and awkward.
 
• **Option 4: "No improvement"** – This would be correct if the sentence was already grammatically correct, but it is not in this case.
